# DAMBROSE

> DAMBROSE is a private, membership-based medical practice in Orlando, Florida, led by board-certified family physician Dr. Michael J. D'Ambrose. It offers comprehensive primary care, internal medicine, prevention, and longevity — built on a lifelong, relationship-based model with direct physician access and full coordination of care across every stage of life.

DAMBROSE serves a limited number of members so that care can be deeper, more personal, and continuous. Unlike concierge clinics focused mainly on access and convenience, DAMBROSE is built around full clinical ownership: one dedicated health team stays involved across decisions, specialists, and settings, so care is integrated rather than episodic. Members typically keep their health insurance for hospital stays, surgeries, and specialist procedures; DAMBROSE complements it with continuous physician involvement.

## Membership programs

- [Alma](https://dambrose.com/alma): Core primary care and internal medicine for diagnosis, treatment, and ongoing clinical care — the backbone of every DAMBROSE membership.
- [Praeva](https://dambrose.com/praeva): A longevity-focused program centered on prevention, risk assessment, and long-term vitality — the performance-minded extension of core care. Can be added at enrollment or later.

## What membership includes

- Direct physician access, including outside standard office hours for urgent questions
- Same-day visits and visits that meet you wherever you are
- Full healthcare coordination, from referral to follow-up
- A physician present at specialist visits and as your advocate in hospital settings
- Continuous, proactive care throughout the year
- Lab work in the comfort of your home or office
- Billed annually; flexible membership terms. Membership does not cover hospital procedures or specialist appointment fees.

## About the physician

- Dr. Michael J. D'Ambrose — Founder & Physician. Board-certified family physician and member of the American Board of Family Medicine, the American Academy of Family Physicians, and the Florida Medical Association.
- Experience spanning outpatient care, hospital medicine, emergency medicine, and obstetrics, devoted to lifelong, relationship-based medicine.
